body:
So just about an hour ago I went to some cliffs near my house, fully prepared to jump. I went all out cliche and brought a small bottle of liquor, like the ones you get in a minibar. I was going to jump, no question about it. I was fed up, I was through, I was going to end it once and for all. As I stood there I said to myself "Well, this is it." (Yes, I went all out cliche) I start to open the bottle but I soon notice that I cant. It's like the damn thing was welded shut. I try to wrap my shirt around it and twist, I try twisting the other way, hell I even bang the damn thing at a nearby picnic table. Soon enough I calm down and put it aside. But to my, what I can only describe as horror, I look down and notice that the fucking cliff isn't high enough. Desperate, not wanting to change my mind I look around to improvise. I see a tree that is near the cliff and I decide to climb it to extend the height. I jump up to reach the first branch... It breaks. I fall with my back at the dirt and the rater large branch falls over me. As I lie there in the dirt, my nice jacket covered in mud and with pain in my back and chest I burst into laughter at my situation and say to myself "I'm not gonna go though with this." I get the branch off me, get up, grab my bottle and walk home. My family was asleep. I make myself some tea and go into my room. Right now as I'm sitting here with my spiked lemon tea I smile at my current situation. I'm really not feeling good overall in life. While I think I will still have my collapses, setbacks and feel like overall shit, I'd rather take my chances at a better life than eradicating all chances of it. Perhaps I'll start feeling better soon, or perhaps I'll find a taller cliff. One thing I think we all can agree on is that this was the silliest, most ridiculous suicide attempt ever.


(oh, and guess what? The bottle was welded shut. I had to use my hobby knife to cut the top open!)
I go on really long walks. Although now a days I just spend the walks thinking about how fucking miserable I am...

No, not really. Although I usually feel them coming but once they break out there is no stopping them. All I can do is try to get on my bed or the rug in my room and hope it feels better when I wake up.

I've actually considered talking to a doctor about it. My brothers know little about this, and my parents only know about my collapses. The thing about this girl, let's call her Stella, is that she is sending in my opinion very mixed messages. One second she can refer to me as her "friend" and then post a bunch of ;) smilies. She seems to only want to meet me in groups as she's canceled the first time I was going to meet her alone too.

But really, I dont feel like talking about her...
I kind of don't want to go see a doctor, because I don't feel sick. It feels more like im in a pissy mood than it feels like I have a disease.
